justification: Writes production rows (v2_is_actionable) on the publish path; governs whether precinct-limited rules reach every house in a council

falsifiable_check.command: pytest tests/test_dcp_area_link_guard.py; read-only unkeyed_precinct_ids per council against production
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a live row that a precinct rule should key stays actionable with no key after a publish, or a check that could not run is not reported
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main rederive_after_publish only prints a warning on failure and has no check of the result; a read-only run of this branch's unkeyed_precinct_ids against production finds 96 live Canterbury-Bankstown rows a precinct rule should key but that have no key (served council-wide now). test_rows_the_rule_should_have_keyed_are_withheld fails on main (no withhold_unkeyed).

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions current rows of councils with precinct RULES (derive_precinct_keys); serving gate is is_current AND v2_is_actionable = true
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: a row a rule selects that is legitimately council-wide would be withheld if _derive returns a key for it; _derive is the same function the derivation uses, so this only happens where the derivation itself would key it
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: runs after every publish from both paths; existing unkeyed rows (96 Canterbury-Bankstown) are withheld at that council's next publish

pre_impl.external_source_error: database connection or query failure returns None and the run is reported NOT VERIFIED by Telegram
pre_impl.frontend_type: none — the API already serves only v2_is_actionable = true
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: a precinct-limited rule disappears from the page until its key is made, instead of appearing on every house

functions.name: withhold_unkeyed
functions.input: the derivation module and one council name after a publish
functions.output: number of rules withheld, or None when the check could not run
functions.if_none: a connection or query failure returns None, never 0

functions.name: unkeyed_precinct_ids
functions.input: an open database cursor, the derivation module and one council name
functions.output: sorted ids of live or pending rows a precinct rule should key but that have no key
functions.if_none: a council with no rules returns an empty list

functions.name: alert_precinct_keys
functions.input: published councils, dry-run flag and a send function
functions.output: Telegram notice of withheld rules or an unverified check
functions.if_none: no notices sends nothing; a send failure is printed, not raised

values.guard_at: TRUE and NULL both withheld; FALSE left alone

queries.where_clause: id = ANY(ids) AND is_current AND v2_precinct_id IS NULL
queries.if_wrong: a row keyed between the read and the update is excluded by v2_precinct_id IS NULL

break_it.scenario: the precinct derivation raises an error for one council after a publish
break_it.what_happens: precinct rules of that council stay live with no key, shown to every house
break_it.how: withhold runs regardless of the derivation's outcome

break_it.scenario: re-paginated PDF fails the page fingerprint and nothing is keyed
break_it.what_happens: all of that rule's rows would be served council-wide while derive returns 0
break_it.how: broken fingerprint withholds every unkeyed live row of the rule

break_it.scenario: withheld row set back to NULL and switched on by routine enrichment
break_it.what_happens: the unkeyed rule reappears for every house after the next enrichment run
break_it.how: withhold writes FALSE, which routine enrichment does not select

break_it.scenario: the production database is down while the post-publish check runs
break_it.what_happens: the run would report success while nothing was checked
break_it.how: returns None; alert says NOT VERIFIED

break_it.scenario: rules live during the minutes between publish commit and derivation
break_it.what_happens: a precinct rule can be shown council-wide briefly, or indefinitely if the worker is killed
break_it.how: known gap: needs withholding inside the publish transaction (follow-up)
break_it.repro: kill the publish job after commit, before derivation

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — next Canterbury-Bankstown publish reports [WITHHELD] 96 or fewer and DQ-143 falls
